name: AneDeath. ~Ane-jini Kakugo no "Otouto-shibori" na Natsu ga Kuru!~
original_name: 姉です。（Death）～姉死覚悟の「弟しぼり」な夏が来る！～
source:
After his parents reconciled, Sakura Takahiro, a student preparing for university entrance exams, was forced to live with his sisters again, but he hadn't seen them at all in the past eight years...

This reunion was sure to be a very touching one, but... the eight-year gap was huge, and they had both grown so much that they were unrecognizable, so... in the end, it turned into a very erotic reunion...

"Come to think of it, I was the youngest child, so when I was little, my older sisters used me as a "toy"...

Suddenly, forgotten and nostalgic(?) memories come back to me... I wonder if I can study properly for the entrance exam here..."

Under the same roof... With a hint of anxiety and naughty fantasies, an exciting life begins now!!!

Thus, he will drown in his sisters' charms! He knows his sisters will be the death of him. The summer of "older sisters squeezing their little brother" is coming, with death by smothering all but inevitable.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/ane_death/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
父母和解后，准备高考的学生佐仓贵宏被迫再次与姐姐们住在一起，但他已经八年没有见到她们了……

这次的重逢，注定是一场非常感人的重逢，但是……八年的差距太大了，两人都成长得都快认不出来了，所以……最后，就变成了一场很色情的重逢……

“说起来，我是最小的孩子，所以小时候，姐姐们都把我当作‘玩具’……

突然，那些被遗忘的、怀念的（？）记忆又浮现在我的脑海里……我不知道我能不能在这里好好学习，准备入学考试……”

同一个屋檐下……带着一丝不安和调皮的幻想，精彩的生活现在开始了！！！

这样，他就会被姐姐们的魅力淹没了！他知道他的姐妹们将会害死他。“姐姐挤弟弟”的夏天即将到来，窒息死亡几乎是不可避免的。

[翻译自[url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/ane_death/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
